question: Which of the following chemical reactions represents the displacement reaction?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Zn(s) + CuSO4(aq) → ZnSO4(aq) + Cu(s)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This is a type of **displacement reaction**, where one element replaces another element in a compound.
 
• In this reaction, **zinc (Zn)** is more reactive than **copper (Cu)**, so zinc replaces copper from copper sulfate (**CuSO4**) to form zinc sulfate (**ZnSO4**) and copper.
